title: They abandoned evil, unwholesome states; they were 'brāhmaṇā' (brahmins). And the name 'brāhmaṇa' was the first name that arose. These people built leaf huts in…
content: They abandoned evil, unwholesome states; they were 'brāhmaṇā' (brahmins). And the name 'brāhmaṇa' was the first name that arose. These people built leaf huts in the forests and meditated in those leaf huts. For them, the red-hot coals were extinguished, the smoke disappeared, the mortar and pestle fell askew. They ate in the evening for the evening meal, in the morning for the morning meal. They went into villages, towns, and capital cities for alms. Having obtained food, they returned to their leaf huts in the forests to practice meditation.

title: - Venerable Bharadvāja, what is the cause, what is the condition why these young bhikkhus, in their prime, with black hair, endowed with the blessing…
content: - Venerable Bharadvāja, what is the cause, what is the condition why these young bhikkhus, in their prime, with black hair, endowed with the blessing of youth, in the spring of life, do not indulge in sensual desires, but live the holy life completely pure for life, and live the full time perfectly?" - "Great King, the Blessed One, the Knower, the Seer, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One, has said: 'Come, bhikkhus, toward those who are only mothers, establish the mind of a mother. Toward those who are only sisters, establish the mind of a sister. Toward those who are only daughters, establish the mind of a daughter.' Great King, this is the cause, this is the condition why these young bhikkhus... live the holy life completely pure for life, and live the full time perfectly.

title: ( Blessed One ): Beautiful parks, Beautiful forests, Beautiful lotus ponds, Are loved by people. They are only worth Little, insignificant. In village or in…
content:
( Blessed One ):
Beautiful parks,
Beautiful forests,
Beautiful lotus ponds,
Are loved by people.
They are only worth
Little, insignificant.
In village or in forest,
On low ground or high,
Wherever an Arahant dwells,
That place is truly beautiful.

title: Elder Gahvaratīriya: In the great forest, bitten by mosquitoes, Like a battle elephant, there one lives mindfully.
content:
Elder Gahvaratīriya:

In the great forest, bitten by mosquitoes,
Like a battle elephant, there one lives mindfully.

title: Possessing these ten qualities, bhikkhus, a person should not be associated with. What ten? Killing living beings, taking what is not given, sexual misconduct, false…
content: Possessing these ten qualities, bhikkhus, a person should not be associated with. What ten? Killing living beings, taking what is not given, sexual misconduct, false speech, divisive speech, harsh speech, idle chatter, covetousness, ill-will, wrong view. Bhikkhus, a person possessing these ten qualities should not be associated with. Possessing these ten qualities, bhikkhus, a person should be associated with. What ten? Abstaining from killing living beings, abstaining from taking what is not given, abstaining from sexual misconduct, abstaining from false speech, abstaining from divisive speech, abstaining from harsh speech, abstaining from idle chatter, non-covetousness, non-ill-will, right view. Bhikkhus, a person possessing these ten qualities should be associated with.

title: Bhikkhus, there are these three kinds of peace. What three? Peace of body, peace of speech, and peace of mind. Bhikkhus, these are the three…
content:
Bhikkhus, there are these three kinds of peace. What three? Peace of body, peace of speech, and peace of mind. Bhikkhus, these are the three kinds of peace.

Peace of body, peace of speech,
Peace of mind, without taints,
One who is perfect in peace,
A sage, is called one who has washed away evil.

title: Bhikkhus, if while walking... while standing... while sitting... while lying down, thoughts of sensual desire, or thoughts of ill-will, or thoughts of harming arise in…
content: Bhikkhus, if while walking... while standing... while sitting... while lying down, thoughts of sensual desire, or thoughts of ill-will, or thoughts of harming arise in a bhikkhu, and if he accepts them, does not abandon them, does not dispel them, does not terminate them, does not make them nonexistent — then, bhikkhus, if while lying down, his consciousness behaves thus, he is called one who is not ardent, not conscientious, constantly lazy, of inferior energy.

title: Elder Bandhura: I have no need for this or that. I live happily, enjoying the taste of the Dhamma. Having drunk the supreme, first sweetness,…
content:
Elder Bandhura:

I have no need for this or that.
I live happily, enjoying the taste of the Dhamma.
Having drunk the supreme, first sweetness,
I will not associate with poison.

title: Rāhula, develop the development like space. Rāhula, by developing like space, agreeable and disagreeable contacts that arise do not take hold of the mind, do…
content: Rāhula, develop the development like space. Rāhula, by developing like space, agreeable and disagreeable contacts that arise do not take hold of the mind, do not remain. Rāhula, just as space is not established anywhere — so too, Rāhula, develop like space. Rāhula, by developing like space, agreeable and disagreeable contacts that arise do not take hold of the mind, do not remain.

title: Whoever checks the arising anger Like a chariot going straight, I call a charioteer. Others merely hold the reins. Conquer anger by non-anger, Conquer evil…
content:
Whoever checks the arising anger
Like a chariot going straight,
I call a charioteer.
Others merely hold the reins.

Conquer anger by non-anger,
Conquer evil by good,
Conquer stinginess by giving,
Conquer falsehood by truth.

Speak the truth, do not be angry,
When asked, give even from little.
By these three conditions,
One may go to the presence of the devas.

The wise do not harm anyone,
Their bodies are always restrained.
They go to the Deathless state,
Where there is no sorrow.
